question: Does RVLGRPOHooks reject an ungrouped Experience when its retained RVL generation prompt_id or prompt differs from the Experience task before train_step is called?
hypothesis: The current training boundary checks generation-to-task identity only when VARE rollout-group metadata is present. An ungrouped Experience with a mismatched RVL generation will reach the trainer.

fixture.trainer: deterministic FakeTrainer; no model, optimizer library, or external service

acceptance.baseline: Both cases demonstrate that mismatched generation provenance reaches FakeTrainer.train_step; the regression must fail on the baseline.
acceptance.candidate: Both cases raise ValueError containing 'task identity mismatch' before FakeTrainer.train_step; optimizer_step remains zero.
falsifiers: The baseline rejects both malformed cases before train_step.
The corrected boundary accepts either malformed case or mutates trainer state before rejecting it.

claim_limits: This is a synthetic source-boundary integrity reproduction, not evidence that historical training data was affected.
No model inference, model training, reward-quality evaluation, coding repair, held-out access, or capability improvement is measured.
The result does not establish an upstream RVL trainer defect; the tested boundary is VARE's RVL adapter.
